Perfect for space exploration, this model offers precise detailing of the lunar surface, making it ideal for scientific research, 3D rendering, and educational purposes.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row content_placement="middle" woodmart_css_id="6613aca852936" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2NjEzYWNhODUyOTM2Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoidmNfcm93IiwiZGF0YSI6eyJ0YWJsZXQiOnt9LCJtb2JpbGUiOnt9fX0=" mobile_bg_img_hidden="no" tablet_bg_img_hidden="no" woodmart_parallax="0" woodmart_gradient_switch="no" woodmart_box_shadow="no" wd_z_index="no" woodmart_disable_overflow="0" row_reverse_mobile="0" row_reverse_tablet="0"][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_column_text css="" woodmart_inline="no" text_larger="no"]

Immersive Moon in 3D for Astronomy and Planetary Science

The Moon 3D model reproduces the lunar landscape with incredible accuracy, allowing users to explore the moon’s surface in unprecedented detail. Whether you are developing an astronomy graphics project, conducting planetary science research, or creating captivating visuals for virtual reality moon experiences, this model provides an engaging tool for any application.

Advanced 3D Rendering with High-Resolution Moon Textures

Our model uses high-resolution moon textures applied to a spherical form using UV mapping. Each of the six texture segments boasts a resolution of 4096x4096 px, providing clarity and reducing distortions at the poles, unlike traditional rectangular textures. This makes it perfect for projects requiring precise 3D rendering and space visualization.

Perfect for Virtual Reality and Space Exploration Projects

This 3D model of the Moon is ideal for use in virtual reality moon simulations, giving users an immersive experience of space exploration. The model's realistic detail and texture mapping make it perfect for showcasing the lunar surface in both scientific and educational applications.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][vc_column
